name: Stormwind Stockade Normal: Hamhock's kit Chain Lightning hits for its 599 base again (#7827)
contract: Hamhock's (1717) Normal kit Chain Lightning (2102502, SmartAI row 9010) casts with custom base points 599
(#7827); #7073 had doubled them to 1198. The spell's single Nature damage effect adds one roll of 1-60 to the
base points minus one, so 599 gives 599-658 and 1198 gives 1198-1257. Its level-20 value scales with
Hamhock's level 28 by at most 11.9663/9.0674 = 1.3197 (BaseDamage for class 2), giving at most 868 for 599
and at least 1581 for 1198 after scaling. The Normal tuning row maps 2102502 to itself (factor 1.0) and the
40% cap of the hero's 1,000,000 health never applies; the damage-taken controls stay at 1000. Hand of
Protection blocks Hamhock's melee and Fierce Blow, and the first cast, 1-2 s after aggro with a 3 s cast
time, lands before his totem or Fierce Blow. One Chain Lightning on the lone hero therefore takes 580-1000
health with 599 and more than 1000 with 1198.
